observations:
Torah #131 does not require any new package types that are not already established in the cross-Torah taxonomy. The single package identified — כבוד / מלכות / צדק — is a direct instantiation of a well-attested package type that recurs throughout Likutay Moharan.

The כבוד ↔ מלכות identification is one of the most common bechina pairs in the entire corpus. The sefirah of Malkhut carries the divine attribute of כבוד (glory/honor) — this is grounded in Psalm 24:7-10 ('מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד') and the Zoharic framework where כבוד names the aspect of Malkhut that receives and radiates divine glory. The equation צדק = מלכות is a foundational Zoharic bechina (standard Aramaic: 'צֶדֶק מַלְכוּתָא קַדִּישָׁא') that appears in numerous Torahs.

The package type 'Holy Kingship / Judgment / Honor' (מלכות + כבוד + צדק) is structurally identical to the מלכות clusters found in many other Torahs — for example, Torah #1's Package 2 (מלכות וחן) and Torah #135's handling of מלכות (edge 1825 in the dataset, immediately preceding Torah #131's edge 1826, also connects מלכות with another concept). The specific focus on כבוד as a spiritually dangerous attribute — because it activates the judgment-dimension of Malkhut — is a distinctive emphasis of this teaching, but it is still the same package type: the Malkhut/Justice/Honor cluster.

No evil-mirror package is warranted from the extant text. The danger of כבוד is described as a functional consequence within an eitza argument (receiving honor improperly → weighed in scales → verdict of guilt → spiritual death), not as a named cluster of evil-domain concepts with bechina relationships among them. The 'כַּף חוֹבָה' (scale of guilt) is an instrument in the judicial process, not a bechina-equated node forming an evil cluster. Unlike Torah #1 where the evil side has named entities (יצר הרע, מלכות הרשעה, עשו) bechina-connected to each other, Torah #131's extant text presents no named evil bechina cluster.

If the complete source text were available (the file currently appears truncated), an evil-mirror package might emerge — particularly if the teaching develops a contrast between proper and improper honor, naming the negative-side concepts with bechina language. This remains unresolvable from the truncated text.

Conclusion: The teaching's full package structure (from the extant text) is captured by one established type — Holy Kingship / Honor / Justice (good) — with no new cross-Torah package type emerging. The NO_NEW_PACKAGES verdict stands pending availability of the complete source text.
